accounts.name: Operating Checking
accounts.description: Primary operating bank account.

accounts.name: Operating Savings
accounts.description: Operating reserves held in savings.

accounts.name: Accounts Receivable
accounts.description: Amounts due to the organization; review as the receivable control account.

accounts.name: Grants Receivable
accounts.description: Uncollected grant awards recognized as receivables.

accounts.name: Pledges Receivable
accounts.description: Uncollected donor pledges recognized under organization policy.

accounts.name: Prepaid Expenses
accounts.description: Payments benefiting future periods.

accounts.name: Property and Equipment
accounts.description: Capitalized property and equipment at cost.

accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation
accounts.description: Contra-asset for accumulated depreciation.

accounts.name: Accounts Payable
accounts.description: Amounts owed to vendors; review as the payable control account.

accounts.name: Business Credit Card
accounts.description: Primary organizational credit-card liability.

accounts.name: Accrued Expenses
accounts.description: Expenses incurred but not yet invoiced or paid.

accounts.name: Deferred Revenue
accounts.description: Receipts associated with future earned revenue.

accounts.name: Refundable Advances
accounts.description: Conditional grants and advances refundable until conditions are met.

accounts.name: Net Assets Without Donor Restrictions
accounts.description: Cumulative net assets without donor restrictions.

accounts.name: Net Assets With Donor Restrictions
accounts.description: Cumulative net assets subject to donor restrictions.

accounts.name: Contributions Without Donor Restrictions
accounts.description: Contribution revenue without donor restrictions.

accounts.name: Contributions With Donor Restrictions
accounts.description: Contribution revenue with donor restrictions.

accounts.name: Grant Revenue
accounts.description: Revenue from grants recognized under applicable conditions and restrictions.

accounts.name: Program Service Revenue
accounts.description: Fees and other revenue from mission-related programs.

accounts.name: Special Events Revenue
accounts.description: Gross revenue from fundraising and special events.

accounts.name: Program Services Expense
accounts.description: Costs directly supporting mission programs.

accounts.name: Management and General Expense
accounts.description: General administration and organizational governance costs.

accounts.name: Fundraising Expense
accounts.description: Costs incurred to solicit contributions and conduct fundraising events.

accounts.name: Payroll Expense
accounts.description: Employee wages and employer payroll costs.

accounts.name: Occupancy Expense
accounts.description: Rent, utilities, and facility operating costs.

accounts.name: Professional Fees
accounts.description: Legal, accounting, and other professional fees.

accounts.name: Grants and Assistance Expense
accounts.description: Grants, awards, and assistance provided to beneficiaries or other organizations.

accounts.name: Depreciation Expense
accounts.description: Periodic depreciation of property and equipment.
